title: EnterpriseStructuredLogEvent
description: Standardized schema for structured JSON application and access log events across microservices.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision (e.g. 2026-08-22T22:30:00.123Z).

logger.description: Hierarchical name of the emitting logger component (e.g. app.service, app.middleware.access).

message.description: Human-readable description of the logged event.

service.description: Identifier of the application service emitting the log.

environment.description: Deployment environment where the log originated (e.g. production, staging, development).

trace_id.description: Distributed trace / correlation identifier for request-scoped event aggregation.

span_id.description: Identifier for the specific operation or service boundary within the distributed trace.

caller.description: Source code location where the log event was triggered.

file.description: Basename or relative path of the source code file.

func.description: Name of the executing function or method.

context.description: Domain-specific contextual metadata and business key-value pairs.

http.description: HTTP request/response telemetry attached by access logging middleware.

path.description: Request URL path without query string.

duration_ms.description: End-to-end request processing latency in milliseconds.

client_ip.description: IP address of the connecting client.

error.description: Structured exception or error details when an error or failure occurs.

type.description: Class or category name of the exception.

message.description: Detailed error message or exception string representation.

stacktrace.description: Execution call stack frames or formatted traceback string.
